title: Share a Reading List
short_description: Practice synchronizing multiple consumers through a composable with module state.
description: LessonCatalog and ReadingList already consume useReadingList, but currently receive independent lists.
Fix the scope of savedLessons so saving a lesson updates both components.
instructions: In useReadingList.ts, move savedLessons outside the useReadingList function.
Keep savedLessons in module scope as one shared ref.
Do not remove readonly or the saveLesson, removeLesson, and reset actions.
You only need to modify useReadingList.ts.

hints.title: Current scope
hints.body: Everything declared inside `useReadingList` is created again on every call.

hints.title: Shared source
hints.body: Declare `savedLessons` after the imports and before exporting `useReadingList`.

hints.title: API
hints.body: Keep returning the same `readonly` ref and the same actions from the composable.
